item.title: Wildlife Tours
item.description: Wildlife tours exploring Bhutan’s protected areas Discover Wilderness with UD Travels Wildlife Tour Bhutan offers exceptional wilderness experiences. Unique Divine Travels delivers expertly guided wildlife tours focused on birding and safaris within protected areas and national parks. Our trained guides provide strong field knowledge and first-aid support. Season: March to May and September to December Itinerary Day 1: Arrive in Paro Reception at the airport by our guide and driver; Drive to Thimphu with optional birding at Jigme Dorji National Park; Evening stroll in Thimphu; and Night halt in hotel.
